ruleDefinitions.name: HackTool - RemoteKrbRelay Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the use of RemoteKrbRelay, a Kerberos relaying tool via CommandLine flags and PE metadata.

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\RemoteKrbRelay\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "RemoteKrbRelay\.exe") OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-clsid\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-target\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-victim\\ .*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-rbcd\\ .*") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-cn\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-computername\\ .*"))) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-chp\\ .*") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-chpPass\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-chpUser\\ .*"))) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-addgroupmember\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-group\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-groupuser\\ .*")) OR ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-smb\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-smbkeyword\\ .*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*interactive.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*secrets.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*service\\-add.*")))
